rules.statement: When a catch exists to log and fall back on failure, filter it on `when (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)` rather than `when (exception is not OperationCanceledException)`, so a cancellation the caller did not request (such as a timeout's `TaskCanceledException`) is treated as a failure.
rules.why: A store timeout surfaces as `TaskCanceledException` while the caller's token is not cancelled; filtering on the exception type lets it escape and skips the fallback, leaving stale state cached.
rules.check: Look for catch filters like `when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)` around calls whose failure should trigger a fallback; flag them unless the filter checks the caller's token instead.

rules.statement: In a test, wait for an asynchronous callback by awaiting a `TaskCompletionSource` that the callback completes, bounded by `WaitAsync` with a timeout, instead of polling with a `DateTime.UtcNow` deadline and a `Task.Delay` loop.
rules.why: Wall-clock polling depends on timing, so the test can flake or run slowly on loaded CI.
rules.check: Look for test loops that check `DateTime.UtcNow` (or a stopwatch) against a deadline and call `Task.Delay` between checks.

rules.statement: Don't ask a private member to take or return read-only collection interfaces instead of the concrete `List<T>`, `Dictionary<TKey, TValue>` or `HashSet<T>` it uses: CA1859 is enforced as a build error and requires the concrete types there; the read-only-interface rule applies only to public and protected signatures.
rules.why: Declaring private helpers with read-only interfaces fails the build under CA1859.
rules.check: Before reporting a concrete collection type in a signature, check the member's accessibility; report it only on public or protected members.

rules.statement: When an architecture decision record's Status says it amends another record, cite the specific decision it actually changes, or cite the record as a whole, never an unrelated decision number.
rules.why: A reader who follows the amendment link otherwise lands on an unrelated decision.
rules.check: For ADR Status lines that say 'amends ADR-N decision M', check that decision M in ADR-N covers the subject this record changes.
